comment: The implementations of orm, in their order: the one language set that the scripts, the tests and the documents of orm read. The PHP extension implements the PHP library (S10 of PRINCIPLES.md). Each implementation names its roots, the globs of its test files, its support files (a module that tests import and that holds no test) and its internal tests (a test of one implementation's own mechanism, with its reason); every other test file of its roots belongs to a feature of contracts/features.json.
